sample_specific_facts.visible_brand_or_product: neon-lime rewards pack and mobile rewards app
visible_moments: small neon-lime object thrown upward between city buildings
phone lock screen showing a completed voucher or reward at 100%
point-of-sale checkout with phone tapped near a payment terminal
minimal white product insert with serif typography reading like a campaign claim
floating product/reward burst with money, a green vehicle, ball, and pack graphics
phone app dashboard showing a score value and reward modules
grocery or retail checkout with phone/payment interaction

reusable_pattern.pattern_name: Reward Pack To App Proof Montage
secondary_tools: HyperFrames for typography, UI inserts, and final edit assembly
structure: Start with a surreal physical product or brand token in the real world
Cut to a phone UI proving progress, points, or reward completion
Show a real-world transaction where the phone creates value
Insert a minimal white typographic claim card or product-pack beauty shot
Use a floating reward burst to visualize upside or winnings
Return to app UI and retail proof to make the benefit feel practical
style_axes: neon accent color against restrained white/black layouts
mix of surreal product motion and grounded real-world proof
phone UI as evidence rather than decoration
camera_and_motion: upward look between city buildings for launch energy
locked-off or handheld checkout closeups for proof
floating product elements radiating outward on white
clean cuts between real footage and graphic inserts
negative_constraints: no fake unreadable app text except abstract numbers or simple labels
no brand-name copying unless assets are supplied
no overcomplicated scene with too many props

prompt_defaults.subject: a neon-lime rewards pack for a mobile loyalty app
prompt_defaults.setting: a modern city and everyday retail checkout locations
prompt_defaults.primary_action: the pack launches upward, transforms into a phone reward notification, then proves value through tap-to-pay checkout and a floating burst of reward icons
prompt_defaults.camera_move: mix of upward city POV, close handheld checkout proof shots, centered phone UI closeups, and clean product insert cuts
prompt_defaults.lighting: natural daylight for real-world shots, crisp white studio light for graphic product inserts
